title: Monotonicity of nondeterministic space
statement: Let $s_1,s_2:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $s_1(n)\le s_2(n)$ for every natural number $n$. Then every language decidable in nondeterministic space bounded by a constant multiple of $s_1$ is also decidable in nondeterministic space bounded by a constant multiple of $s_2$; equivalently, $\mathrm{NSPACE}(s_1)\subseteq\mathrm{NSPACE}(s_2)$.
hypotheses_covered: $s_1,s_2$ are functions from natural numbers to natural numbers
